subject: Multi-vendor observability: retention consolidation & consolidated quote request
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@datadog.com>, Lina Ahmed <lina@grafanacloud.com>, Sentry Renewals <renewals@sentry.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-vendor observability: retention consolidation & consolidated quote request

Hi Ethan / Lina / Sentry team —

We’re planning our Q1 retention and log-storage renewals and would like a consolidated view of options across Datadog, Grafana Cloud, and Sentry. Goal is to pick a combination that reduces unit cost for long-term logs while keeping hot/warm access for recent traces and SLO-related metrics.

Quick context: Redwood Inference current monthly log ingress ~12 TB (post-ingest), peak index/query workload in region us-west-2. Current split: ~65% Datadog (ingestion + APM/metrics), ~25% Grafana Loki for infra logs, ~10% Sentry for error events. We’re evaluating 30/90/365-day retention profiles and cold-tier export (object storage) for 365-day buckets.

Requested from each vendor by EOD Thu Dec 3:
- Itemized quote for 30/90/365 day retention (hot/warm/cold), including any tiered discounts for multi-product commitments
- Line items for egress, rehydration, and log-processing costs (parsing/ingest pipelines)
- Any migration/export tooling credits or consultation hours that reduce one-time migration cost
- Suggested pilot approach (if applicable) and expected timeline

I attached a billing snapshot and usage summary to help size proposals. We’re particularly interested in:
- A combined pricing scenario if we increase Grafana cold storage to absorb 365-day logs vs keeping everything in Datadog
- Any cross-vendor incentives you can extend (multi-year or committed volume discounts)

Thanks — looking to consolidate vendor responses and present a recommendation to finance + engineering on Friday.

Attachments: observability_invoice_snapshot_Nov2026.csv (CSV, 18KB), usage_summary_nov2026.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

—
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Platform Tools
Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@datadog.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 19:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor observability: retention consolidation & consolidated quote request

Hi Monica / Neha —

Thanks for the context and the files. I’m attaching a preliminary Datadog quote with three retention profiles plus a blended scenario that shows savings if you shift 40% of 365-day logs to object storage with rehydration on demand. High-level notes:

- 30-day (default): standard pricing, no major savings unless you change ingest parsing or reduce retention for non-critical sources.
- 90-day: ~12% lower unit cost vs 30-day when amortized across current volume.
- 365-day with object storage: Biggest lever — by moving archival data to object storage (S3) and applying Datadog’s cold-tier retention we estimate ~30% reduction in monthly bill for log storage; rehydration costs apply (we included a conservative estimate).
- Offer: 6 months of zero-fee export assistance + one week of free migration engineering for Redwood if you sign a 12-month commit for ingestion volumes >= current baseline.

Attachment: datadog_quote_Q4_2026.pdf (PDF, 42KB)
Pricing portal link: https://app.datadoghq.com/pricing/quote/ethan-blake-OBS-2026

If helpful I can set up a 30-minute call to walk through the assumptions tomorrow afternoon.

—
Ethan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Observability
Datadog
From: Lina Ahmed <lina@grafanacloud.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-vendor observability: retention consolidation & consolidated quote request

Hi Monica / Neha —

Appreciate the detailed ask — attached is our estimate for Grafana Cloud (Loki + Mimir) options. Two quick points:

- Loki long-term storage (S3-compatible) is typically the lowest-cost destination for 365-day logs if you can route JSON/text logs there for query-by-need.
- We offer a hybrid approach: keep high-cardinality, metrics-linked logs in Datadog for fast queries and move lower-cardinality infra logs to Grafana cold storage. This reduces cross-vendor rehydration frequency and lowers overall cost.
- Pilot suggestion: pick one non-customer-critical service (approx ~2 TB/month) and run a 6-week pilot to validate query latency and rehydration behavior. We’ll provide a one-week onboarding migration credit for the pilot.

Attachment: grafana_cloud_estimate_dec2026.pdf (PDF, 36KB)

Happy to join the call — I have availability Thu Dec 3 10:00–12:00 PT.

—
Lina Ahmed
Account Executive, Grafana Cloud

Subject: Re: Multi-vendor observability: retention consolidation & consolidated quote request

Team —

Summary of vendor replies so far (copied):
- Datadog: provided a 30/90/365 quote with an offer for 6 months of export assistance and one week of migration engineering if we commit to 12 months.
- Grafana: proposed Loki cold-tier as the low-cost destination and offered 1 week of onboarding credit for a 6-week pilot.
- Sentry: haven’t heard back from renewals yet — I’ll follow up separately.

Suggested next steps before Friday finance sync:
1) Schedule a 45-min negotiation + engineering review Thu Dec 3 @ 11:00 PT (proposed).
2) Goal: structure a blended contract that uses Datadog for high-cardinality logs/APM, Grafana for bulk cold storage, and Sentry retention add-on for error events only. Target net savings: 20–30% compared to a pure Datadog 365-day approach.
3) Procurement: if vendors can provide final line-item quotes and DocuSign-ready documents by EOD Thu we’ll route to PO.

Quoted below is Ethan’s note for visibility. Monica — can you confirm meeting and whether the procurement team should prepare a draft PO template?

Hi team —

Procurement confirms receipt of final vendor PDFs and recommends the blended approach: Datadog (hot/high-cardinality + 90-day), Grafana (365-day cold storage for bulk logs), Sentry (maintain error events at 365-day). We’ve drafted a PO and coordinated DocuSign routing for the following:
- Purchase order: purchase_order_2026-OBS-004.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
- DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/secure?doc=OBS-2026-004 (expires in 7 days)

Notes:
- Datadog’s export assistance will be accepted; we’ll take the 1 week migration credit from Grafana for the pilot.
- Target start date for pilot: Mon Jan 4, 2027 — migration window Jan 4–Jan 15.
- Procurement will request final signed vendor contracts and create a 12-month vendor ledger to track commit/usage parity.

Please review the PO and sign via DocuSign so we can finalize the billing cadence.
